import http.server
import json
import sqlite3

database = "/var/lib/lab/lab.db"

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        connection = sqlite3.connect(database)
        connection.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS visits (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")
        connection.execute("INSERT INTO visits DEFAULT VALUES")
        visits = connection.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits").fetchone()[0]
        connection.commit()
        connection.close()
        body = json.dumps({"service": "LabCentral Example A", "visits": visits}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
